instruction: Repair transactions.apply(initial, operations), a deterministic in-memory nested-transaction interpreter. initial maps string keys to integers. Operations are ["begin"], ["set", key, integer], ["commit"], or ["rollback"]. begin snapshots current state; rollback restores its matching begin; commit retains current state but leaves the outer rollback snapshot unchanged. set outside a transaction is allowed. A commit/rollback without an open transaction, unknown operation, or an open transaction at end raises ValueError. Other operation shapes are valid. Return a new final dictionary without mutating either input.
